pairs.target: gé le liǎngtiān , tǎ wéi sònghuán jièlái de zhíchǐ , zài huàtú shì ménwài kànjiàn yīwén zuòzài dìshàng .
pairs.english: Two days later, returning a borrowed ruler, Tavi found Iven sitting on the floor outside the drawing room.
pairs.hanzi: 隔了两天，塔维送还借来的直尺，在画图室门外看见伊文坐在地上。

pairs.target: yìzhāng dà tú pù zài liǎngkuài jiē qǐ de mùbǎn shàng , sìjiǎo yā zhe shítou .
pairs.english: A large map lay over two joined boards, its four corners weighted with stones.
pairs.hanzi: 一张大图铺在两块接起的木板上，四角压着石头。

pairs.target: tā de xiùzǐ juàn dào zhǒu shàng , zhèng yòng xiǎodāo guādiào zhǐ shàng de yídào mòxiàn . pángbiān zhàn zhe gè gāoniánjí xuéshēng , lǐngkǒu bié zhe tóng kòu , shǒulǐ ná zhe yíjuàn xìshéng .
pairs.english: With sleeves rolled to his elbows, he was scraping an ink line off the paper with a small knife. An older student stood beside him, a copper clasp at his collar and a coil of thin cord in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他的袖子卷到肘上，正用小刀刮掉纸上的一道墨线。旁边站着个高年级学生，领口别着铜扣，手里拿着一卷细绳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde tā . shàng huí yuànzi lǐ chànggē , dé mǎ chàng yàn jǐ de chángdiào , zhège rén xián tíngdùn tàijiǔ , méi tīng wán jiù zǒu le .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized him. At the last courtyard singing, when Dema sang the long Goose Ridge song, this man had disliked the long pauses and left before the end.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得他。上回院子里唱歌，德玛唱雁脊的长调，这个人嫌停顿太久，没听完就走了。

pairs.target: yīwén táitóu , jiào tǎ wéi bāngmáng yāzhù qiàoqǐlái de bǎn jiǎo , yòu zhǐzhe túshuō , sāntiān hòu xuégōng kāimén ràng wàitou de rén kàn xuéshēng de dōngxī , zhè zhāng tú yào guà zài jìnmén de láng xià .
pairs.english: Iven looked up, asked Tavi to hold down a curling board corner, and pointed at the map: in three days the academy would open for visitors to see student work, and this map would hang in the entrance corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文抬头，叫塔维帮忙压住翘起来的板角，又指着图说，三天后学宫开门让外头的人看学生的东西，这张图要挂在进门的廊下。

pairs.target: tóng kòu xuéshēng bǎ shéngzi shōu jìn zhǎngxīn , zì bào míngzì , jiào wén qí . tā guǎn tú fú hé xuánguà , yīwén gǎi shuōmíng , liǎnggè rén cóng zǎoshàng jiù méishuōdào yíchù .
pairs.english: The copper-clasp student gathered the cord into his palm and introduced himself as Wenqi. He handled the map’s format and hanging, while Iven revised its caption; they had disagreed all morning.
pairs.hanzi: 铜扣学生把绳子收进掌心，自报名字，叫闻祁。他管图幅和悬挂，伊文改说明，两个人从早上就没说到一处。

pairs.target: " búshì túhuà cuò le . " yīwén shuō , " shì kōng dé tài gānjìng . "
pairs.english: “The map is not wrong,” Iven said. “The blank is too clean.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是图画错了。”伊文说，“是空得太干净。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià kàn . héliú yòng hěn xì de lánxiàn huà zài dàolù xiàfāng , liǎngtiáo chàliú zhījiān méiyǒu dìmíng , dǎo yǒu yìméi xiě dé hěnpiàoliang de fāngwèi biāo .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to look. A very fine blue line marked the river below the roads; between its two branches were no place names, but there was a beautifully lettered direction marker.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下看。河流用很细的蓝线画在道路下方，两条岔流之间没有地名，倒有一枚写得很漂亮的方位标。

pairs.target: nán chà bú zài shàngmiàn , jiù huán dūn yě méiyǒu . zhè shì tā chū ménqián jiàn guò de nà yìzhǒng lù tú , shānlù , huànchē de dìfāng hé shōuhuò diǎn dōu hěn qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Southbranch was missing, and so was Old Ring Pier. It was the kind of road map he had seen before leaving, with mountain roads, cart changes and receiving points all clear.
pairs.hanzi: 南汊不在上面，旧环墩也没有。这是他出门前见过的那一种路图，山路、换车的地方和收货点都很清楚。

pairs.target: " běnlái jiùshì wǎnglái dàolù tú . " wén qí shuō , " shuǐlù lìng yǒu tú . guà zài ménkǒu de dōngxī , bùnéng shénme dōu wǎng shàng sāi . "
pairs.english: “It is a road-traffic map to begin with,” Wenqi said. “Waterways have their own maps. You cannot cram everything into something hung at the entrance.”
pairs.hanzi: “本来就是往来道路图。”闻祁说，“水路另有图。挂在门口的东西，不能什么都往上塞。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . dàn láikàn de rén bù zhīdào pángbiān háiyǒu lìng yìzhāng . " " nà bǎ tímù xiě dà . "
pairs.english: “I know. But visitors do not know there is another map beside it.” “Then make the title bigger.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我知道。但来看的人不知道旁边还有另一张。”
“那把题目写大。”

pairs.target: yīwén gēxià dāo . tā guādiào de nà dào mò , shì xiǎng tì nán chà yǐnchū de duǎnxiàn , xiànxià yǐjīng qǐ le máo .
pairs.english: Iven put down the knife. The ink he had scraped away was a short line meant to point to Southbranch, and the paper beneath was already fuzzy.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文搁下刀。他刮掉的那道墨，是想替南汊引出的短线，线下已经起了毛。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nà kuài dìfāng , hūrán juéde zìjǐ shuōhuà dé xiǎoxīn : tā zhī cóng chàkǒu jīngguò , méiyǒu qùguò nán chà , lián zuǒbiān shuǐshēn duōshǎo yě méi wèn chéng .
pairs.english: Looking at that patch, Tavi suddenly felt he must speak carefully: he had only passed the fork, never visited Southbranch, and had not even managed to ask how deep the water on the left was.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那块地方，忽然觉得自己说话得小心：他只从岔口经过，没有去过南汊，连左边水深多少也没问成。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhè jǐyàng xiān shuō le , yòu gàosù tāmen , nǚrén jiào dí qīng , zhù de dìfāng shì tā zìjǐ shuō de .
pairs.english: He said these things first, then told them the woman was named Diqing and had told him herself where she lived.
pairs.hanzi: 他将这几样先说了，又告诉他们，女人叫荻青，住的地方是她自己说的。

pairs.target: wén qí tīng wán , zhǐzhe zhǐ shàng de yìtiáo zhīliú wèn , nà dí qīng de jiā zài zhèlǐ , háishì zài wǎng xià yíduàn .
pairs.english: After listening, Wenqi pointed at a tributary on the paper and asked whether Diqing’s home was here or a stretch farther downstream.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁听完，指着纸上的一条支流问，那荻青的家在这里，还是再往下一段。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dá bú shànglái . tīng tā shuō de shíhòu , tā juéde hěn hǎo dǒng , tāndào tú qián cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ lián tā suǒzhǐ de " nàbiān " dōu méi jì zhǔn .
pairs.english: Tavi could not answer. It had seemed easy to understand as she spoke; only before the map did he realize he had not even precisely remembered what she meant by “over there.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答不上来。听她说的时候，他觉得很好懂，摊到图前才发现，自己连她所指的“那边”都没记准。

pairs.target: " kě tā zhēn zhù zài nàlǐ . " yīwén shuō . " wǒ méi shuō tā shì nǐ biān de . " wén qí de méitóu yě zhòu le qǐlái .
pairs.english: “But she really lives there,” Iven said. “I did not say you invented her.” Wenqi frowned too.
pairs.hanzi:
“可她真住在那里。”伊文说。
“我没说她是你编的。”闻祁的眉头也皱了起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng yāzhù bǎn jiǎo de shǒu huàn le yìbiān . yīwén liǎnshàng nà yìdiǎnhóng , tā hěn shúxī . yàoshi zhèhuìer yǒurén quàn tā biéjí , tā dàgài huì gèng jí .
pairs.english: Tavi switched the hand holding the board corner. He knew that redness in Iven’s face well. If someone now told him to calm down, he would probably get more upset.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将压住板角的手换了一边。伊文脸上那一点红，他很熟悉。要是这会儿有人劝他别急，他大概会更急。

pairs.target: wàitou yǒurén tuō lái yìzhāng zhuōzi , zhuōtuǐ guāguò dìmiàn , sāngè rén bùdébù děng nà shēngyīn guòqù .
pairs.english: Someone outside dragged over a table, its legs scraping the floor, and all three had to wait for the noise to pass.
pairs.hanzi: 外头有人拖来一张桌子，桌腿刮过地面，三个人不得不等那声音过去。

pairs.target: wén qí wānyāo shì lā guàshéng , mùbǎn zhōngjiān qiàoqǐ , shítou huá dào tú biān , yīwén lìkè shēnshǒu lánzhù .
pairs.english: Wenqi bent to test the hanging cord; the board rose in the middle, and a stone slid to the map’s edge. Iven immediately reached out to stop it.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁弯腰试拉挂绳，木板中间翘起，石头滑到图边，伊文立刻伸手拦住。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén yìqǐ bǎ tú tái shàngzhuō , gāngcái zhēng de nà kuài kòngbái bèi shǒuzhǎng dǎng le yíhuìer , zài lùchū lái , réng shì kòngbái .
pairs.english: Together they lifted the map onto the table. Their palms briefly hid the disputed blank, and when it emerged again it was still blank.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人一起把图抬上桌，刚才争的那块空白被手掌挡了一会儿，再露出来，仍是空白。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ dé mǎ zhǐ shàng nà yíduàn méi kànjiàn de pōjiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the unseen stretch at the foot of the slope on Dema’s drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起德玛纸上那一段没看见的坡脚。

pairs.target: " néng bunéngbú zài zhè zhāng shàngmiàn huà ? " tā wèn , " wǒ bǎ qùguò de nà yíduàn lìng huà chūlái . nán chà xiě zài pángbiān , xiě dí qīng shuō de , bù bǎ hé wān huà chéng liáng guò de . "
pairs.english: “Could we draw it separately?” he asked. “I can draw the stretch I travelled. Write Southbranch beside it, as Diqing’s account, without making the river bends look surveyed.”
pairs.hanzi: “能不能不在这张上面画？”他问，“我把去过的那一段另画出来。南汊写在旁边，写荻青说的，不把河弯画成量过的。”

pairs.target: wén qí méiyǒu lìjí dāying . tā xiān wèn yào duō dà , yīwén yǐjīng zhǎochū yìzhāng zhǐ , wǎng dà tú yòubiān yì bǎi . zhǐ gàizhù le yuánlái de shuōmíng .
pairs.english: Wenqi did not agree immediately. He first asked how big; Iven had already found a sheet of paper and placed it to the right of the large map. It covered the original caption.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁没有立即答应。他先问要多大，伊文已经找出一张纸，往大图右边一摆。纸盖住了原来的说明。

pairs.target: " nà wǒ de zì yòu dé zhòngchāo . " tā shuō . " nǐ běnlái jiù shuō yào gǎi . " wén qí shuō .
pairs.english: “Then I will have to copy my lettering again,” he said. “You said you wanted to change it anyway,” Wenqi said.
pairs.hanzi:
“那我的字又得重抄。”他说。
“你本来就说要改。”闻祁说。

pairs.target: yīwén dèng tā yíxià , jiāng xiǎo zhǐ yí dī . liǎnggè rén liáng le bàntiān , zànshí zài xiàfāng liúchū yíkuài wèizhì .
pairs.english: Iven glared at him and moved the small sheet lower. After much measuring, they provisionally left a space beneath.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文瞪他一下，将小纸移低。两个人量了半天，暂时在下方留出一块位置。

pairs.target: tímù yě yào zhòngxiě , míngshuō zhè shì lùlù huànchē yǔ yùnhuò de tú ; pángbiān de xiǎo tú zhī jì lǚtú suǒ jiàn , bùnéng ná qù xíngchuán .
pairs.english: The title would be rewritten too, explicitly calling it a map of land cart changes and freight; the small adjoining sketch would record only travel observations, not serve as a navigation chart.
pairs.hanzi: 题目也要重写，明说这是陆路换车与运货的图；旁边的小图只记旅途所见，不能拿去行船。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying dāngtiān bǎ cǎogǎo sònglái . tā dài zhe kōng zhǐ chūménshí , wén qí hūrán jiàozhù tā , wèn jiù huán dūn shì shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi promised a draft that day. As he left with the blank paper, Wenqi suddenly stopped him and asked what Old Ring Pier was.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应当天把草稿送来。他带着空纸出门时，闻祁忽然叫住他，问旧环墩是什么。

pairs.target: " hébiān hěndà de yíduàn shí huán . " " zuò shénme yòng ? " " bù zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “A very large section of stone ring by the river.” “What is it for?” “I do not know.”
pairs.hanzi:
“河边很大的一段石环。”
“做什么用？”
“不知道。”

pairs.target: wén qí xiǎng le yíxià , ràng tā xiān bié huà chéng qiáo , zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu jiàn guò bànjié jiù yáo , huà yuǎn le yě xiàng qiáodòng .
pairs.english: Wenqi thought a moment and told him not to draw it as a bridge yet; as a child he had seen half an old kiln that looked like a bridge arch from far away.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁想了一下，让他先别画成桥，自己小时候见过半截旧窑，画远了也像桥洞。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōhǎo , jiāng zhǐjuàn sōng yìxiē , miǎnde zài yāchū yídào zhé .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed, rolling the paper loosely to avoid pressing another crease into it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说好，将纸卷松一些，免得再压出一道折。

pairs.target: huíqù de lùshang , tā jīngguò dōng yuàn . mǐlā zhèng gěi liǎngzhī xīn kuàng tú fángshuǐ liào , sū yǐ jǔ zhe yípiàn kuān yè , wèn tā zhè dōngxī yào cóng nǎér guòqù .
pairs.english: On his way back he passed the east courtyard. Mira was coating two new frames with waterproofing; Suyi held a broad leaf and asked where this was supposed to get through.
pairs.hanzi: 回去的路上，他经过东院。米拉正给两只新框涂防水料，苏苡举着一片宽叶，问她这东西要从哪儿过去。

pairs.target: mǐlā ná jiǎo gōu lái dèngzǐ , jiào tǎ wéi yǒukōng jiù zuò , méikòng bié dǎng tàiyáng .
pairs.english: Mira hooked a stool over with her foot and told Tavi to sit if he had time, or stop blocking the sun if he did not.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿脚勾来凳子，叫塔维有空就坐，没空别挡太阳。

pairs.target: tā zài tāmen pángbiān tānkāi zhǐ , xiān huà zìjǐ zuò guò de chuán . hé de lìngyìbiān , tā liú le yìdiǎn kōng , zhǔnbèi bǎ nàge nǚrén shuō dehuà xiě zài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: He spread the paper beside them and first drew the boat he had travelled on. Across the river he left a little space, planning to write the woman’s words there.
pairs.hanzi: 他在她们旁边摊开纸，先画自己坐过的船。河的另一边，他留了一点空，准备把那个女人说的话写在那里。
